item.title: Orange County’s Josh D’Amaro to Lead Walt Disney Co.
item.description: The Walt Disney Co. has found its new leader—a 28-year company veteran who began his career at Disney’s most prized asset, Disneyland. Orange County’s Josh D’Amaro, who oversees the company’s most profitable division, will succeed Bob Iger as chief executive effective March 18. item.title: Medtronic to Buy CathWorks for $585M
item.description: Four years ago, CathWorks and Medtronic plc, one of the world’s largest medical device makers, struck up a co-promotion agreement with the option for Medtronic to buy the Irvine-based cardiac-focused device maker within five years. Last week, Medtronic exercised that option and announced it was acquiring CathWorks for $585 million, including potential undisclosed earn-out payments.
